description: Known advisories accepted for now. Each entry: advisory (GHSA id), package, reason (why it cannot be fixed or does not apply), reviewBy (YYYY-MM-DD; past that date the stage gate fails again). Entries are added only with the reason written in the stage report.

exceptions.reason: No fixed release. Only imported by bittorrent-tracker's tracker-server UDP parser (lib/server/parse-udp.js); the BitTorrent plugin runs the tracker client only, so isPublic is never reached.
Dev-only: @electron/asar inside the packaging toolchain globs the repository's own build output; the fix needs glob 14, a major the toolchain does not accept yet.
Dev-only: electron-builder's @electron/universal matches fixed patterns from the repository's own build config; the fix needs minimatch 11, a major the toolchain does not accept yet.
